description: Source code for the PdfPage class in the PDFsharp library, representing a page in a PDF document with properties and methods for page size, orientation, media box, annotations, and content streams.

classes.name: PdfPage
classes.description: Represents a page in a PDF document with properties for size, orientation, media box, annotations, content streams, and methods for managing page state and resources.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up the page size based on MediaBox or default page size depending on setupSizeFromMediaBox flag.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the page, preventing further modifications.

methods.name: UpdateOrientation
methods.description: Updates the page orientation based on width and height.

methods.name: GetFontName
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a resource name for a font used on the page.

methods.name: TryGetFontName
methods.description: Attempts to get the resource name of a font by its ID.

methods.name: GetFontName
methods.description: Gets the resource name of a font data within the page.

methods.name: GetImageName
methods.description: Gets the resource name of an image within the page.

methods.name: GetFormName
methods.description: Gets the resource name of a form within the page.

methods.name: WriteObject
methods.description: Serializes the page object for PDF output, including transparency groups if needed.

methods.name: InheritValues
methods.description: Inherits resource and box properties from a parent dictionary.

methods.name: PrepareForSave
methods.description: Adjusts page boxes based on trim margins before saving.
